item.title: EDITORIAL: The News wins 20 awards in state-wide contest
item.description: The Daily Eastern News staff won a combined 20 awards at the Illinois College Press Association conference Saturday in Chicago. The News won four first place awards, eight second place awards, two third place awards and six fourth place awards. item.title: Eastern Illinois University on-campus enrollment drops 9.5% in spring
item.description: EIU’s on-campus enrollment dropped 9.5% this semester compared to last spring, with sharply falling international enrollment and a growing freshman class size highlighting the changes.
